rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: zkShare is a privacy-oriented context API for storing encrypted facts and generating verifiable proofs that answer yes/no questions without exposing underlying data. Its MCP server exposes tools for storing encrypted facts and generating proofs, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search. The server is published as an npm package and registered in the official MCP Registry.
